messages:
maria_marketing: Heads-up team 1: Glimmer Systems case study interview confirmed for Thu 10am PT with their Head of ML. Goal: blog + short launch post + webinar in two weeks. Need hero quote, logo permission, and legal OK on any metrics. Who owns what?

jonas_growth: I'll handle webinar slotting and the inbound routing (campaign=glimmer-case). Need final publish URL 48h before webinar.

claire_content: I'll take transcript + three social snippets + two short clips (30s/60s). Plan: ASR -> 1-pass edit. Drop raw audio into shared drive after call.

rachel_design: I'll prepare hero image variations and request an SVG logo from Glimmer. Can someone confirm logo permission in writing?

legal_team: Please send any verbatim metric claims and the intended copy to legal-review@redwood.com. If claims reference third-party partners, we need explicit permission from Glimmer to publish names. Standard review ETA is 48 hours.

maria_marketing: Action list:
- Ask Glimmer for written logo permission + permission to name partners (if said)
- Capture exact metric phrasings during interview and paste into this thread
- Claire to tag lines as [CLAIM: verify] in transcript

claire_content: Will do. Also putting two headline options in the doc after editing. One will be metric-forward, one qualitative.

jonas_growth: If legal needs redactions and it delays webinar promo, we'll still publish the blog and social on schedule and hold webinar emails until cleared. I'll keep nurture flow queued but not live.

rachel_design: Quick ask1: anyone have a 1-line webinar blurb? I can use it for the hero.

maria_marketing: Draft blurb: "See how Glimmer Systems cut inference latency and scaled throughput using Redwood Inference". Claire, please craft a shorter hook for the signup.

promo-bot: Note: embargo placeholder set for 2026-04-12 09:00 PDT if legal clears by 2026-04-10 17:00.

maria_marketing: Great. I'll request written logo OK from Glimmer now and add legal@ to the shared folder. Posting raw audio + timecodes here after interview. Thanks all.
